title: New book explores 100 of Britain's 'most haunted' places
excerpt: A new book will take readers on tour of the UK's "most haunted" places.
content:
Samanta Gladkauskaite

Fri, 2 October 2026 at 4:00 am UTC

A new book will take readers on a tour of the UK's "most haunted" places.

Spooky Britain by Peter Naldrett features 100 destinations, from "eerie" pubs and "creepy" museums to sites known for witchcraft and stories about vampires.

The book includes both well-known places, such as the Ghost Tour of the Lanes in Brighton and Whitby's Dracula experiences, as well as hidden spots known only to locals.

It also provides practical advice for those interested in experiencing the supernatural, including what makes each location unique and how to best experience it.

The book aims to explain why these places continue to captivate ghost-hunters and thrill-seekers.

The variety of places featured in the book is extensive, including corpse roads in the Lake District, the haunted halls of Chillingham Castle and the secrets of London's Clink Prison.

The book invites readers to step into the shadows and discover stories that refuse to die.

Peter Naldrett is a freelance writer who specialises in travel and the outdoors.

He has written a number of guidebooks, as well as four books in the Dog Walkers' Guide series.

He has also written for magazines such as Geographical, The Big Issue, Dalesman and The Daily Telegraph.
